title: Fan Out Without the Bookkeeping
description: Write two concurrent fan-outs with sync.WaitGroup.Go: one that collects results in input order, and one that counts hits from many goroutines safely.
short_description: Let the WaitGroup do the counting
learning_objectives: Start goroutines with wg.Go instead of Add and Done
Collect ordered results by writing to an index rather than appending
Share a counter across goroutines with sync/atomic
Recognise what wg.Go does not give you
real_world_connection: Fanning out over a list of ids and gathering the answers is the shape of most concurrent Go anyone writes: batch lookups, parallel health checks, multi-source aggregation.
requirements: FetchAll returns results in the same order as ids
FetchAll runs the fetches concurrently, not one after another
CountMatching counts correctly with 500 goroutines running at once
Both wait for every goroutine before returning
bonus_points: Swap atomic.Int64 for a plain int and watch which test starts failing
Rewrite FetchAll with Add and Done to see how much longer it gets
